name: Olympic Games
summary: The greatest of the crown games, held for Zeus at midsummer every fourth year in the Altis — founded, the Olympians' own tale ran, on Pelops' chariot victory over Oenomaus, whose mound stood beside the course.
testimonia: Pindar, Olympian 1 (Pelops and the race as the games' charter myth)
The penteteric anchor joins the reconstructed calendar in M12.5 — no conventional dates in v1
